changes: The existing native Notes runner now scopes detail-read and delete faults to the id observed when reopening its own newly created note.
D67 covers an injected detail transport failure, an injected successful missing-row response, terminal retry and Back controls, and recovery through a real detail GET.

D68 covers an injected delete transport failure, an injected zero-affected-row response, editor and draft retention, renewed confirmation, a real successful delete, and absence after a live list reload.
The runner holds an owned autosave before the successful delete and checks that releasing it causes no later autosave dispatch.

evidence.native: notes-final-native-20260930a passed D61, D62, D63, D67, and both injected D68 failure states. It stopped before successful deletion when the runner's single immediate textarea hit test returned editor_control_not_hittable. The blocking element was not recorded, so the cause is not proven. No product failure is inferred.
evidence.correction: The runner now waits up to ten seconds for an elementFromPoint-confirmed hit on the active Notes control, tests five interior points, and records only content-free occlusion categories if none becomes hittable. Input remains trusted CDP pointer and keyboard events. Native rerun pending.

prior_synthetic_note: The failed run did not delete its note. Its ignored raw receipt was privately preserved before a rerun at test-results/notes-native-acceptance-20260930a.json (0600). Cleanup must use the Notes UI and match the exact owned id from that receipt to a detail GET before confirming deletion; do not delete a title match alone.
